modules.subtitle: Axial - T1 (cadaver, unlabelled)
modules.credit: Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine
modules.notice: Images only - this cadaver series carries NO labels. It is kept as the source for hand-authored labelling; for a labelled brain use the living 7 T modules.

modules.title: Brain - MRI
modules.subtitle: Coronal - living 7T T1
modules.notice: One healthy volunteer, scanned at 7 tesla for research - not a clinical scan. Brightness varies strongly across these images: that is a 7 T coil artefact, so the temporal lobes and cerebellum look darker here than they would at 1.5 T or 3 T. Compare shapes and positions, not brightness. Labels were placed by automated segmentation (SynthSeg) with no human correction, cover whole structures only - there are no named gyri, sulci, lobes or white-matter tracts, so the corpus callosum and internal capsule are unlabelled - and left and right are deliberately not asserted.
